title.zh: 配置存储空间的清单规则
title.en: Configure an inventory rule for a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Bucket的拥有者以及被授予PutBucketInventory权限的用户才能发起配置清单规则的请求。

- 配置清单规则前需生成一个RAM角色，该角色需要拥有读取源Bucket所有文件和向目标Bucket写入文件的权限。首次使用清单功能时，建议您通过OSS控制台进行配置。清单规则配置完成后，您可以获取拥有所有权限的RAM角色。有关配置清单规则中RAM角色的权限说明，请参见[存储空间清单](~~163489~~)。

- 单个Bucket最多只能配置1000条清单规则。

- 配置清单的源Bucket与存放清单文件的目标Bucket必须位于同一个Region。
descriptions.en:
- Only the bucket owner and users who have been granted the PutBucketInventory permission can initiate a request to configure an inventory rule.

- Before configuring an inventory rule, create a RAM role that has the permissions to read all objects in the source bucket and write objects to the destination bucket. If you use the inventory feature for the first time, configure the inventory rule in the OSS console. After the inventory rule is configured, you can obtain a RAM role that has all required permissions. For more information about the permissions of the RAM role in an inventory rule, see [Bucket inventory](~~163489~~).

- You can configure up to 1,000 inventory rules for a single bucket.

- The source bucket for which the inventory is configured and the destination bucket that stores the inventory lists must be in the same region.
